name: OpenSpace
tagline: 在 iOS 17.0–17.3.1 上实现主屏幕自由布局与小组件尺寸切换。
description: OpenSpace 让主屏幕图标保留在任意网格位置，并提供更方便的小组件尺寸切换。
关闭总开关并 Respring 后即可返回原始系统布局。
features: 主屏幕图标可停留在任意空白网格位置
在小组件快捷菜单中切换支持的尺寸
可在设置中立即保存当前布局
关闭后恢复原始系统布局
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的 OpenSpace。
开启总开关，并按提示 Respring。
移动图标或通过小组件快捷菜单选择需要的尺寸。
需要返回原始布局时，关闭总开关并 Respring。

changes: 新增在设置中立即保存当前布局。
修复 Respring 后图标空白位置或页面排列可能变化的问题。
增强多页面自由布局的保存与恢复体验。

en.name: OpenSpace
en.tagline: Free Home Screen placement and widget size controls on iOS 17.0–17.3.1.
description: OpenSpace lets Home Screen icons remain in any grid position and adds convenient widget size controls.
Disable the main switch and Respring to return to the original system layout.
features: Keep Home Screen icons in any empty grid position
Choose supported sizes from the widget shortcut menu
Save the current layout immediately from Settings
Return to the original system layout when disabled
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open OpenSpace in Settings after installation.
Enable the main switch and Respring when prompted.
Move icons or choose a supported size from a widget shortcut menu.
To restore the original layout, disable the main switch and Respring.

changes: Added an option to save the current layout immediately from Settings.
Fixed icon gaps or page ordering changing after a Respring.
Improved saving and restoration of free layouts across multiple pages.
